independent_context_leads.observation: At least 12 reported maritime incidents September 28–October 5, comprising attacks, attempts and harassment; IMO independently registered nine as of source report.
independent_context_leads.caveat: Neither tally equals 12 tankers destroyed; reconcile incident IDs, source methodology and publication clocks.

independent_context_leads.observation: Kpler reported daily strait transit and crude movement sharply reduced; roughly 10.1 million bpd through the strait, about 74% of pre-war, with alternative route volumes partly offsetting.
independent_context_leads.caveat: Different denominators and geographies; no inference of unimpeded shipping or total collapse.

independent_context_leads.observation: Vortexa September Gulf oil flows excluding Iran averaged approximately 81% of prewar rate; crude/condensate 91%; refined fuels about 60%.
independent_context_leads.caveat: September baseline is not October 12 operating-state evidence; requires refreshed time series.

independent_context_leads.observation: Satellite-image investigation verified damaged or destroyed 217 structures and 11 pieces of equipment at 15 U.S. sites using images reviewed through April 14.
independent_context_leads.caveat: Site damage does not establish all bases destroyed or all functions shut down; no October current readiness inference.

independent_context_leads.observation: UAE rescue of 22 seafarers from burning tanker; AP reports suspected mine involvement.
independent_context_leads.caveat: Do not conflate with asserted photo or resolve mine-versus-drone attribution from this one source.

independent_context_leads.observation: Reuters reported U.S. dollar near 18-month high amidst regional tensions and inflation focus.
independent_context_leads.caveat: Current exchange-rate observation neither proves long-run currency immunity nor petroleum commodity backing; do not conflate market signal with causation.

independent_context_leads.observation: Reuters reports continuing Riyadh airport disruption and mixed regional equity response following Houthi attacks.
